preset.note: On-device ONNX serving. The port is assigned dynamically at service start, so it must be read from `foundry service status` or GET /openai/status rather than assumed — 5273 and 5272 both appear in Microsoft's own examples. Requests need the full model id (Phi-4-mini-instruct-generic-cpu), not the CLI alias, and models unload after ten idle minutes by default.

fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to https://oai.endpoints.kepler.ai.cloud.ovh.net/v1.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: EU-hosted unified gateway. Model ids are load-bearing and irregularly punctuated (Meta-Llama-3_3-70B-Instruct); never normalize them.

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://PARASAIL_API_KEY. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to https://api.parasail.io/v1.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: parasail- prefixed model ids; per-model thinking controls (chat_template_kwargs, thinking_budget) via provider_options.

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://PERPLEXITY_API_KEY. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to https://api.perplexity.ai.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: Grounded web search built in; search_results ride on the raw payload (retain_raw=True), search filters via provider_options.

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://POE_API_KEY. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to https://api.poe.com/v1.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: Hundreds of models and community bots behind one subscription. Model ids are bot names and are capitalized (Claude-Sonnet-4.6). n must be 1, parallel_tool_calls is unsupported, audio input is ignored, and json_schema response_format is not supported — the weakest structured-output mechanism wins here. Private bots are unreachable through this endpoint.

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://PORTKEY_API_KEY. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to https://api.portkey.ai/v1.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: Routing, caching and fallbacks over many providers. Selecting the upstream needs x-portkey-* headers (provider, config); pass them as configured headers. Point base_url at your own host when self-hosting.

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://PPIO_API_KEY. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to https://api.ppio.com/openai.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: Formerly PPInfra: the host moved to api.ppio.com/openai, and the widely copied api.ppinfra.com/v3/openai is the legacy spelling. Model ids are vendor-namespaced (deepseek/deepseek-r1) and a /community suffix marks the free trial tier of the same weights.

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://QIANFAN_API_KEY. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to https://qianfan.baidubce.com/v2.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: v2 takes a single permanent bearer key shaped bce-v3/ALTAK-<id>/<secret> — pass it whole, since the embedded slashes are part of the key. Do not mix it with the deprecated v1 AK/SK OAuth flow; that pairing is the usual integration failure. Thinking is parameter-driven and spelled per model family ('thinking' or 'enable_thinking') via provider_options.

fields.help_text: Only needed if this server was started with authentication. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: Container-based runner. The port is only a starting point: if 8080 is taken it picks the next free one, so check what `ramalama serve` printed rather than assuming.

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://REKA_API_KEY. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to https://api.reka.ai/v1.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: Multimodal (image/video/audio). tool_choice spells the forced case 'tool', not 'required'.

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://REQUESTY_API_KEY. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to https://router.requesty.ai/v1.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: vendor/model ids across many upstreams. Reports usage.cost in USD on buffered responses; streaming needs stream_options.include_usage for it.

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://RUNPOD_API_KEY. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: https://api.runpod.ai/v2/<endpoint_id>/openai/v1
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: The base URL embeds your serverless endpoint id. vLLM extras (top_k, best_of, guided decoding) ride through provider_options; set RAW_OPENAI_OUTPUT on the worker if streaming chunks arrive misshapen.

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://SAMBANOVA_API_KEY. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to https://api.sambanova.ai/v1.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: Model listing reports live per-model pricing and context metadata.

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://SARVAM_API_KEY. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to https://api.sarvam.ai/v1.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: Indic-language models. Its own header is api-subscription-key, but a bearer token is accepted for OpenAI compatibility and is what this preset sends. Reasoning is ON at 'low' by default — pass an explicit null through provider_options to disable it. Open-weight models live on /v2 instead.

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://SCW_SECRET_KEY. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to https://api.scaleway.ai/v1.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: EU-sovereign; ids carry quantization suffixes (:fp8, :int4). presence_penalty is supported but frequency_penalty is not.

fields.help_text: Only needed if this server was started with authentication. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:30000/v1.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: Engine extras (separate_reasoning, top_k, min_p) via provider_options.

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://SILICONFLOW_API_KEY. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to https://api.siliconflow.com/v1.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: The .com host serves the international account; api.siliconflow.cn is the mainland one and keys are not interchangeable. Thinking is parameter-driven via provider_options ({'enable_thinking': …, 'thinking_budget': 128-32768}) and defaults to ON — DeepSeek-V3.1 needs it false for function calling.

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://SNOWFLAKE_PAT. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: https://<account-identifier>.snowflakecomputing.com/api/v2/cortex/v1
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: Base URL embeds your account identifier; authenticate with a programmatic access token. n, presence_penalty, logprobs, stop and logit_bias are ignored.

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://SPARK_API_PASSWORD. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to https://spark-api-open.xf-yun.com/v1.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: The HTTP surface takes a single bearer APIPassword from the console — not the legacy AppID/APIKey/APISecret triple, which belongs to the WebSocket path and does not work here. The console renders that password in an APIKey:APISecret shape; paste it whole rather than splitting on the colon.

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://STEP_API_KEY. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to https://api.stepfun.com/v1.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: Step models. The subscription surface is a different path on the same host (/step_plan/v1), so point base_url there for plan traffic — billing differs. Its Anthropic-compatible endpoint is /step_plan without the /v1, which the Anthropic SDK appends itself.

fields.help_text: Only needed if this server was started with authentication. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://TOGETHER_API_KEY. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to https://api.together.ai/v1.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: Large open-model catalog; org/model ids (e.g. deepseek-ai/…). /v1/embeddings verified 2026-08-12 (docs.together.ai/reference/embeddings); response carries no usage block, so embed() usage stays unset for this provider.

fields.help_text: Only needed if this server was started with authentication. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:9000/v1.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: The OpenAI frontend listens on 9000 — port 8000 is Triton's own KServe HTTP endpoint, not this one.

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://UPSTAGE_API_KEY. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to https://api.upstage.ai/v1.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: Solar family; reasoning_effort semantics differ per model — solar-mini rejects the parameter entirely, solar-open2 reasons unless disabled.

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://VAST_API_KEY. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: https://openai.vast.ai/<endpoint_name>
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: The base URL ends in your endpoint name and carries no /v1. The model field is required by the protocol but ignored by the proxy — the endpoint's own MODEL_NAME decides what runs, so send any non-empty string.

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://VENICE_API_KEY. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to https://api.venice.ai/api/v1.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: Privacy-focused; max_tokens is deprecated in favour of max_completion_tokens. Web search and thinking controls via provider_options ({'venice_parameters': …}).

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: creator/model ids across upstream providers; gateway-normalized reasoning object.

fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: International (BytePlus) endpoint; the mainland edition is a separate account and host (ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3). Doubao models. Thinking controls go through provider_options ({'thinking': …}).

fields.help_text: Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to https://api.voyageai.com/v1.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://WATSONX_API_KEY. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: https://<region>.ml.cloud.ibm.com/ml/gateway/v1
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: The OpenAI-compatible model gateway (beta, IBM Cloud only), which sidesteps the native API's request-body project scoping and version pinning — providers are registered per project ahead of time instead. IBM's own example passes the Cloud API key straight through as api_key; an exchanged IAM bearer token also works, but then it expires and the client must refresh. Models are addressed provider-namespaced (openai/gpt-4o).

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://XAI_API_KEY. Accepts env:// and credential://.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to https://api.x.ai/v1.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.help_text: Only needed if this server was started with authentication. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:9997/v1.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: Serves many models at once; ids are the model UIDs you launched. Cluster mode puts the same API on the supervisor host.

fields.help_text: Conventionally env://ZAI_API_KEY. Accepts a literal, env://VAR, or credential://system/name.
fields.label: API key

fields.help_text: Defaults to https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4.
fields.label: Base URL

preset.note: GLM model family; temperature range is 0-1, thinking controls via provider_options ({'thinking': {'type': …}}).
